word: _*ynymy-Nb*_ Ben-y@miyniy sometimes (with article inserted; see below)
pronunciation: ben-yem-ee-nee' ben-hah-yem-ee-nee' ben-eesh' yem-ee-nee'; eesh yem-ee-nee'; yem-ee-nee'; ben-ay'yem-ee-nee'
definition:
Benjamite = "a son of the right hand"

 1) one of the tribe of Benjamin

 _*ynymyh-Nb*_ Ben-ha-y@miniy with 0376 inserted (#1Sa 9:1)
 _*ynymy vya-Nb*_ Ben-'Iysh Y@miyniy son of a man of Jemini;
 or short (#1Sa 9:4; Es 2:5) _*ynymy vya*_ 'Iysh Y@miyniy a man of Jemini,
 or (#1Sa 20:1) simply _*ynymy*_ Y@miyniy a Jeminite;
 (plur. _*ynymy ynb*_ B@niy Y@miyniy )
